example_sentences_in_bangla: ভাই ভাই ঠাঁই ঠাঁই হয়ে গেছে, আর কোনো যোগাযোগ নেই।
প্রত্যেকের ঠাঁইঠাঁই থাকলে পরিবারের ঐক্য নষ্ট হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: The brothers have gone their separate ways, with no contact anymore.
When everyone has their own separate abodes, family unity is lost.
history: This idiom is part of the Bengali proverb 'ভাই ভাই ঠাঁই ঠাঁই', reflecting traditional family dynamics where siblings establish independent households after growing up.
note: Often used to describe familial separation in rural or semi-rural contexts.
